title: device-ness-is-decided-at-the-shim
intention: Settle what makes a thing a device in Cairn — the shim FITTED to it and the protocols it answers, not a class it inherits — and derive the base device from the librarian, which Akien names as its template.
why: Akien, 2026-08-11: 'a shim fits TO the device; you + your shim = your device.' Calibre was a UU device with no device code at all — just its shim — because Calibre itself managed the books. Device-ness therefore cannot be inheritance, and no class read can ever see an external device. Today BaseDevice IS the physics (Law 4) and it enforces the axis we no longer hold, which is why writing the rule down again is not the fix: with the rule stated plainly in conversation, CC still measured device-ness by reading BaseDevice inheritance twice in the same session. A rule that loses to a habit inside one session is not a rule yet.
traces_to: Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy; BaseDevice is the physics enforcing the wrong axis. Law 3 — 'is it a device?' is a behavioral question and a class read is a proxy for it; Akien's 2026-08-11 health-query ruling ('every device has a presence on the bus and can respond to a health query... as to census, what census?') already named asking the running thing as the real measurement.

falsifier.proves_red: DONE when 'is X a device?' is answered by ASKING X — a health query over the bus — and a Calibre-shaped member passes: external, shim only, no Python device object, inheriting nothing. HORIZON: the predicate must be RUN against the live roster at least once; a written-but-unrun predicate is exactly the prose this ticket exists to replace. WRONG INTENT if the librarian does not generalize — the tell is that extracting the base leaves the librarian unchanged and the base carrying only fields no second device wants.

watchme.enough_corrected: THE FIRST CLAUSE WAS UNREACHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION and the build caught it while arming the probe. A poke only happens when the difference is NON-zero, and 'enough' is asked ONLY AFTER A FIRE (BaseShim.on_pulse) — so 'zero across three pokes' describes a state that produces no pokes at all. The watch could never clear. THE TICKET CONTRADICTED ITSELF IN THE SAME BLOCK: 'consumer' already read 'a divergence PERSISTING PAST enough raises to the trouble lane', which only parses if enough is reachable while the divergence stands. The consumer clause is the coherent half. CORRECTED: enough is reached when the AXIS IS RULED — sibling ticket runtime-role-is-a-second-axis at [PROVED] — because that is when 'the claims do not match the shims' stops being a finding and becomes either conformance work or a settled distinction; a standing watch on a settled question is Law 1's defect. THE SECOND CLAUSE SURVIVES INTACT and is now satisfied by construction rather than by discipline: divergence() exercises the predicate over the whole union on every read, so no firing can report a set it did not exercise.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: both sets named per component and their symmetric difference. Starts at 5, not 6 — see 'corrected'; the 6 was a filename census standing in for a class census.
watchme.nexus: the device roster tree — the same tree roster() reads.
watchme.consumer: Akien at his gate for the first three pokes; a divergence persisting past 'enough' raises to the trouble lane.
watchme.trigger_corrected: WHAT WAS ACTUALLY BUILT FIRES ON THE HEARTBEAT, NOT ON A recompile_gate.sh POKE, and the difference is named here rather than left for a reader to discover by diffing the spec against the file. The probe is a cairn.tools.base.probe.Probe berthed at cairn/tools/base/probes/device_claims_match_shims.py; ground_loop's discovery pass arms it and BaseShim.on_pulse evaluates it once per beat. NO NEW FIRING PATH WAS BUILT — which was the cast's stated reason — and it is measurably weaker wiring than the cast asked for, not stronger, so both halves get said. WHY IT CHANGED: hooking recompile_gate.sh would have meant building a new firing path INTO A SHELL SCRIPT to avoid building one, while the probe primitive already has a firer that arms by folder discovery with no registration at all. THE TENSION THE CAST WAS RIGHT ABOUT, AND IT IS NOT RESOLVED: the cast wrote 'No clock', and the heartbeat IS a clock — a one-second poll that re-evaluates this predicate whether or not anything changed. That is the shrinking-footprint discipline (event-fired over periodic scan) being traded away for the arming path, deliberately and with the cost stated. A charter write is the event that would actually matter here; nothing in the probe primitive can yet be armed by one. That is the residue, and it is the same shape as the debt on the horizon constant: a real event exists and we are sampling instead of subscribing. MEASURED, so this is not theoretical: the built path worked on its first live opportunity — bus envelope a813b9fd37964d42a99bd93321c22a4a, base -> harbor_master, 2026-08-11T14:20:07.

closed.what_closed: Device-ness is a CALLABLE now (cairn/tools/base/deviceness.py) instead of an inheritance read, it composes ground_loop.discovery rather than re-deriving membership, and it admits the Calibre shape — the external member with a probes/ folder, no class, no import — which the old axis was structurally blind to. The divergence it exposes is LOUD: a probe at cairn/tools/base/probes/, armed by folder discovery with no hand-registration, carrying both axes PER COMPONENT.
closed.the_finding: 12 ruled devices; 11 of them subclass nothing; 8 subclass BaseDevice and are off the roster the beat reads, INCLUDING bus and ground_loop — the spine is not a device under the ruling; symmetric difference 19 of a 20-member union; exactly one component (librarian) on all three axes. THE MECHANISM WAS NEVER MISSING — Akien's folder ruling shipped in 2081efa before this ticket opened, and this ticket's own falsifier was already satisfied eleven times over by code on disk. What was missing was that nothing anywhere SAID SO. An empty disagreement and an unmeasured disagreement have byte-identical resting states.
closed.what_it_does_not_decide: WHICH AXIS WINS. That is the sibling ticket runtime-role-is-a-second-axis, at Akien's signature gate, and it is this watch's stopping condition (enough). The chart's bounds put naming the axis explicitly OUT, so the probe stands and reports rather than dispositioning 19 components on its own authority — a probe carries no authority (Law 6).
closed.it_fired: NOT ARMED-AND-UNTESTED: the probe poked on the LIVE BEAT before this ticket closed. Bus envelope a813b9fd37964d42a99bd93321c22a4a, base -> harbor_master, 2026-08-11T14:20:07, carrying both per-component lists, the spine named, the unbuilt health clause, and the ticket pointer. Six links — beat, reconcile, shim, crossing-detect, carrier, bus — none of them a hand.
still_open_and_named: NOBODY HAS READ THE POKE. harbor_master's inbox holds it; no consumer has dispositioned it. The back-edge it suggests is the owner's act, not this voyage's.

THE HEALTH-QUERY CLAUSE IS UNBUILT.
